title: A Day in My Life
introduction: Read about a simple daily routine. Notice the time expressions and present simple verbs.
paragraphs: My name is Alex. I get up at seven o'clock every morning. I have breakfast with my family. Then I go to school by bus.
My classes start at eight thirty. I have lunch at school. I go home at three o'clock and do my homework. In the evening, I read a book or play football. I go to bed at ten.
